title: Bloomberg This Weekend | Iranian Tanker Sinks, Push For Peace in Ukraine, State of the Labor Unions
description:
The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by BBC Chief International Correspondent Lyse Doucet, AFL-CIO President Liz Shuler, Michigan Rep. Haley Stevens and California Rep. Kevin Kiley.
